NDT software in Freeport, Texas: built for resident crews at chemical sites

NDT software in Freeport, Texas has to fit a work pattern that is different from most refinery towns: long-term resident crews inside large chemical complexes, called out by unit, cost centre and work order, with turnaround surges on top. The Atlantis ERP solution tracks certificates, equipment, assignments, reports, timesheets and invoicing in one system configured for that model. Demo and quote on request.

Freeport and the Brazosport area around it, including Lake Jackson, Clute and Angleton, are dominated by chemical manufacturing. Dow's Texas Operations in Freeport is Dow's largest integrated manufacturing site. BASF runs a large Freeport site, Olin operates chlor-alkali and epoxy production, and Shintech makes PVC nearby. Freeport LNG liquefies and exports gas on Quintana Island, Port Freeport handles cargo and project freight, and a short drive inland at Old Ocean sit the Phillips 66 Sweeny refinery and Chevron Phillips Chemical's Sweeny complex. The Strategic Petroleum Reserve's Bryan Mound site is just outside town.

The Freeport NDT contractor profile reflects that. Many companies keep technicians resident on a single owner's site for months or years under a service agreement, doing UT thickness surveys, PMI on alloy piping, ferrite checks on duplex and stainless, PAUT and RT on repairs, and MT and PT on rotating equipment. The owners run strict contractor safety programs with site-specific orientations, and many audit their contractors' quality systems. Low-lying Brazoria County sits squarely in the hurricane path, so fall work plans carry storm contingencies. Radiography licensing is with the Texas Department of State Health Services.

Inspection management software for resident contracts in Freeport

Inspection management software for a Freeport resident contract has to track many small jobs under one agreement. In the Atlantis ERP each agreement can be set up as a project with client PO, contract, methods, codes, scope and acceptance criteria, and each call-off becomes a task carrying method, technician, component, result, indication and defect counts and procedure and WPS references.

That structure matters when a plant's reliability group raises a steady stream of work orders across several units. Every report records the work order, request, drawing and contract numbers, so the owner's inspector can trace a UT thickness report back to their own request without a separate cross-reference sheet. Safety induction and work permit fields on the project keep site-access requirements visible, and the Surveys app can collect client feedback at the end of each quarter. KPI dashboards show open work by status, calibration due, certificates expiring and equipment overdue for return, which is the kind of summary a resident supervisor is asked for in the weekly contractor meeting. See Project and Dashboards.

NDT reporting software for Freeport chemical and alloy work

NDT reporting software in Freeport has to cover the methods chemical plants use most: UT thickness, PMI, ferrite, hardness, PAUT and RT. The Atlantis ERP includes those among its 17 report types, each with its own numbering sequence and method-specific fields.

PMI reports verify alloy on replacement piping and fittings, ferrite reports record readings on duplex and stainless welds, and hardness reports sit alongside PWHT reports for repairs that need heat treatment. UT thickness readings are logged by direction; PAUT captures focal laws and RT captures source, technique and IQI type and placement. Weld lines record defect type and orientation for each joint. Each report goes through draft, in progress, review, approved and sent, with inspector, reviewer and approver signatures and a third-party inspector field, and records whether the result is acceptable, not acceptable or acceptable with remarks.

Many Freeport owners have their own reporting format. Company templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML are versioned, and Excel templates fill automatically by mapping fields to cells. The offline field app handles units where phones must stay in airplane mode or signal drops inside concrete structures. See NDT Reports and Digital Twin Reporting Software. For clients who want results on a 3D model, Atlantis Digital Twins shows indications and thickness trends by component.

Technician certification tracking software for owner audits

Technician certification tracking software is what an owner's contractor auditor will test first. The Atlantis ERP records every certificate with scheme, level, method, certifying body, issue and expiry dates, industry sector, OJT and training hours, exam results and attachments, and marks each as active, expiring soon, expired or revoked.

Certificate templates per scheme hold validity in months, whether a vision test or exam is required, and minimum OJT and training hours, so your written practice rules are applied the same way to every technician. Examination sheets hold general, specific and practical scores against the passing score. Vision tests are recorded with Jaeger near vision, far vision, colour perception and contrast results, examiner and clinic. The NDT profile keeps radiation safety training, badge number and medical fitness expiry. Warnings appear 90 days before expiry, and email alerts go to the resident supervisor and QA manager.

Company certifications, such as your ISO 9001 certificate or owner-specific approvals, are tracked with their own alert days, so the contract never lapses on paperwork. Timesheets warn when a technician's certificate is not valid. See Certificates.

Procedure control and NCR/CAPA for Freeport quality systems

Freeport chemical owners expect a contractor's procedures and corrective actions to be controlled, not just filed. The Atlantis procedure register records document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, acceptance criteria and body text or file.

Procedures go through draft, submitted, reviewed, approved and published, with the people and dates at each step; approved revisions are locked and every revision keeps a snapshot. When an owner asks for a PMI procedure for a new alloy, the AI-assisted first draft gives your Level III a starting point, which he or she then reviews and approves. Approvers get email reminders. NCR/CAPA workflows for your own quality system, for example a report issued on the wrong procedure revision, are configured during implementation so the root cause and corrective action are recorded. See Procedures.

Calibration management software for site-based equipment

Calibration management software for resident crews has to handle equipment that lives on a client site for months. The Atlantis ERP tracks each instrument, probe and PMI analyser by serial number, with calibration frequency, status, next due date and the person it is issued to, and warns when assigned equipment is out of calibration.

Calibration records hold provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag and result, and the certificate register keeps the lab accreditation number and PDF with valid, expiring and expired status. Reservations prevent a turnaround crew from taking the resident team's PAUT unit for the same dates. Movement records show inbound and outbound transfers between your yard and each site. Consumables carry reorder levels, and the maintenance log records repairs, firmware updates and probe replacements. See Asset Management.

Crew dispatch and scheduling software for Brazosport sites

Crew dispatch software for Freeport has to balance resident crews with turnaround surges without pulling the wrong person off site. Team Assignments tracks every job from planned to closed, blocks double-booking of technicians and equipment serials, and shows each technician's utilisation and next available date.

The availability calendar records assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable, fed by Time Off requests. Mobilisation and demobilisation dates and site GPS coordinates are held per assignment, useful when crews move between Freeport, Quintana Island and Old Ocean. When a storm threatens, the scheduler can see every crew's location and reschedule from calendar, kanban or list views. See Team Assignments.

NDT quoting and invoicing software for cost-centre billing

NDT quoting and invoicing software in Freeport has to bill the way chemical owners account: by unit, cost centre and work order. The Atlantis ERP invoice lines carry cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type and days or hours, with labour, equipment and consumables subtotals.

Timesheets record work type, method, site, client, equipment serial, billable flag and rate multiplier, with approval, and feed billing directly, so a monthly resident invoice split across several cost centres is built from approved hours rather than retyped. Quotations for extra scope carry job type, site, dates and applicable codes and convert to sales orders on online acceptance. The financial dashboard shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, EBITDA and outstanding invoices over 12 months. See Invoicing and Timesheets.

ERP for NDT companies in Freeport: integration with owner systems

An ERP for NDT companies in Freeport often has to exchange data with a client's maintenance system. The Atlantis ERP has an open REST API that integrates with SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation. Typical uses are receiving work orders and returning report status, or sending approved timesheets to your accounting package.

Integration is optional. Many Freeport contractors start with the ERP as their own system of record and exchange reports with the owner as PDFs or owner-format Excel files, then add an API link once the contract justifies it. Either way, the technician, equipment and report data stays in your system, so when a resident contract changes hands at rebid time, your history of work, qualifications and calibration goes with you rather than living in the owner's database.

Storm season and continuity for Freeport crews

Brazoria County's exposure to Gulf storms means an NDT company in Freeport needs to know, at any moment, where every technician, instrument and source is. The Atlantis ERP holds that in one place: current assignment and site GPS coordinates for each technician, issued equipment by serial and person, and vehicle assignments with project and driver in the Fleet app, including which trucks can carry radioactive sources.

When plants begin shutdown procedures ahead of a storm, the scheduler can pull the list of open assignments, mark crews as demobilised and see which instruments still need to come back to the yard. The KPI dashboard shows issued equipment overdue for return. Afterwards, restart inspections on flooded or wind-damaged equipment are usually urgent and short-notice, and the availability calendar shows immediately who is back, who is on leave and who is still displaced. Because the data is cloud-hosted and the field app works offline, reports written during the recovery sync once power and coverage return. Chemical owners often ask contractors how they will staff post-storm inspections; having real availability and equipment data makes that answer concrete.

NDT software for small NDT companies in Freeport

Not every Freeport contractor has a resident team at Dow or BASF. Smaller companies serve fabrication shops, machine shops and valve repair businesses around Freeport, Clute and Angleton, often with a handful of technicians and one Level III. For them, the most useful starting set is certificates, asset management with calibration, NDT reports and invoicing. That covers the questions any customer's QA will ask and removes the evening spent assembling report PDFs. Dispatch, CRM, procedures and eLearning can be switched on later without migrating data. If your technicians need ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based NDT training, the eLearning portal and the Practical NDT 3D simulator are available too.

Implementing the Atlantis ERP in Freeport

  1. Map each resident contract: units, cost centres, work order flow and report formats.
  2. Load technicians, certificates, vision tests, company certifications and the instrument register.
  3. Configure templates, procedures and NCR/CAPA workflow.
  4. Set up timesheet work types, cost centres and invoice layout.
  5. Pilot with one resident crew, then extend to turnaround crews.
  6. Ongoing support from Atlantis NDT, led by an ASNT NDT Level III.

Frequently asked questions

Can the ERP manage a long-term resident contract?

Yes. The contract is a project and each call-off is a task with method, technician, component and result, linked to the owner's work order.

Does it support PMI and ferrite reporting?

Yes. Both are standard report types with their own numbering, review and approval.

Can we bill across several cost centres?

Yes. Invoice lines carry cost centre, method, technician and equipment serial, fed from approved timesheets.

Can it exchange data with an owner's SAP or Maximo?

The open REST API supports that, scoped per implementation.

Does it track our company ISO certificate?

Yes. Company certifications are tracked with alert days and email reminders.

Is it suitable for a small NDT company?

Yes. Small companies usually start with certificates, reports, asset management and invoicing, and add modules later.
